title: Meta's Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps | TechCrunch
summary: Meta’s AI companion, Muse, is now one of only a dozen mobile apps to have reached 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days on the market. Muse also hit another milestone that demonstrates active engagement with the AI app.
